title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 028 ]

blocks.text: Sometime you say something you really don't mean. But words once spoken, like bullets once fired, can't be recalled. Before you say some thing needlessly hurtful, calm down. Speak with reason not just emotion, Otherwise you may say something you'll regret always.

readingSentences.english: Sometime you say something you really don't mean.
readingSentences.korean: 때때로 당신은 진심으로 의도하지 않은 말을 할 때가 있다.

readingSentences.english: But words once spoken, like bullets once fired, can't be recalled.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 한 번 발사된 총알처럼 한 번 입 밖에 낸 말은 다시 주워 담을 수 없다.

readingSentences.english: Before you say some thing needlessly hurtful, calm down.
readingSentences.korean: 불필요하게 남에게 상처를 주는 말을 하기 전에 마음을 가라앉혀라.

readingSentences.english: Speak with reason not just emotion.
readingSentences.korean: 단지 감정에 치우치지 말고 이성을 가지고 말하라.

readingSentences.english: Otherwise you may say something you'll regret always.
readingSentences.korean: 그렇지 않으면 당신은 평생 후회할 말을 하게 될지도 모른다.
